<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">X＝現在位置のパーセク数。パーセク0に配備する。航行速度＝1。「革命」の影響を受けない。ゲーム開始時に出したならライトサイドが先攻。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star.

'''Card text:''' X = the parsec number of the current location. Deploy at parsec 0. Hyperspeed = 1. Not affected by Revolution. If put out at the start of the game, the Light Side goes first.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 革命 for Revolution.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Death Star|Death Star]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Death Star (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R32 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Death-Star-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
